slides.title: Build More Secure Apps
slides.subtitle: Scan your codebase locally before submission

slides.title: What Is Security Check
cards: Built into the Shopify AI Toolkit and Shopify CLI as a developer command.
Scans codebases, extension point configurations, and dependencies.
Catches common security vulnerability patterns before release.

left.label: Execution
left.title: How It Runs
items: Runs locally on your machine via Shopify CLI
Prompt coding agents directly for checks
Open source engine hosted on GitHub

right.label: Compatibility
right.title: Framework Agnostic
items: Works with React Router, Rails, Django, Laravel

slides.title: What Findings Include
cards: Identifies the exact affected file and line number.
Provides severity level and reasoning for the issue.
Shows sample code snippets and official docs links.

slides.title: Implications & Hygiene
events: Catch authentication gaps and merchant data isolation flaws prior to app store reviews.
Iterate and fix issues seamlessly without switching your existing tech stack.
Integrate into every release cycle, starting with critical and high-severity findings.

slides.title: Shared Responsibility
slides.subtitle: A clean security report does not guarantee absolute security. Use as a complement to existing internal reviews.
